findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure network connection or SSRF
 * @description Checks for usage of urllib/urllib2 that might be vulnerable to SSRF or use insecure protocols (HTTP).
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/insecure-network-connection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 *       external/cwe/cwe-319
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "patch", "request"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential network request found. Verify URL validation (SSRF) and protocol security (HTTP vs HTTPS)."
findings.hypothesis: The package might be making network requests using urllib/urllib2 without proper validation of the URL (SSRF) or using insecure protocols (HTTP).

message.text: Potential network request found. Verify URL validation (SSRF) and protocol security (HTTP vs HTTPS).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name User-controlled URL in urllib
 * @description Traces user input to urllib calls to identify SSRF or open redirect vulnerabilities.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssrf-urllib
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SsrfConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::LocalSourceNode // Broaden to local sources to catch CLI args
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("urlopen").getACall()
      |
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SsrfFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SsrfConfig>;
import SsrfFlow::PathGraph

from SsrfFlow::PathNode source, SsrfFlow::PathNode sink
where SsrfFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential SSRF: URL from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: User-controlled input flows into urllib.urlopen, leading to SSRF.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic hashing
 * @description Using weak hashing algorithms like MD5 or SHA1 can lead to collision attacks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto-hashing
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-327
 *       external/cwe/cwe-328
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("Crypto").getMember("Hash").getMember(["MD5", "SHA1"]).getMember("new").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("cryptography").getMember("hazmat").getMember("primitives").getMember("hashes").getMember(["MD5", "SHA1"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Usage of weak cryptographic hashing algorithm."
findings.hypothesis: The package might be using weak hashing algorithms like MD5 or SHA1, which are vulnerable to collision attacks.
